note: THE ONE MAP from a path to what it takes to change it. Read by the contributor hand-off, by the shipper (both lanes) and by the tests. Classified by PATH only, never by what a line says. A path in no zone is OWNER: the default is deny. Where two patterns match, the more specific one wins (more folders, and a file beats a folder); two zones holding the very same pattern is an error the tests catch. Compared in lower case, composed Unicode, so a path that a Mac treats as the same file is the same here. AUTOMATIC: reversible, and never run by a job that holds power. SHIP-IT: runs with power or decides what is trusted, so it needs the owner's 'ship it'. GOALPOSTS: defines what counts as correct, so it is never shipped by a word. LOCK: decides who may merge what, so it needs 'ship it' and the strictness check. The structural test (test/unit/pipeline/zones.test.js) holds the rules that make AUTOMATIC safe.
